artworks.title: Saint Joseph and the Christ Child with Angels and Putti
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown wash, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a multitude of figures engaged in a dynamic and chaotic scene. The composition features human-like figures in animated poses swirling around the canvas. Many figures seem to be gesturing, reaching, or interacting with each other, creating a sense of movement and tension. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of the Mannerist period, characterized by exaggerated forms and intricate compositions. The figures are drawn with an emphasis on elongated bodies and exaggerated poses, contributing to the sense of drama. The use of ink and washes adds depth and texture to the forms, making the composition appear lively and energetic.

artworks.title: The Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple
artworks.medium: black chalk with pen and brown ink and brown wash, heightened with white gouache on laid paper washed light green-blue
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene with an architectural backdrop. The scene depicts figures in flowing robes interacting, set against columns and steps suggesting a classical or historical theme. The architectural elements imply a temple or significant structure. The drawing uses lines and shading to convey depth and detail.

artworks.title: Falsehood Is the Cause of All Evil (recto); An Allegory of Truth and Falsehood (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and ink with wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures, a structure, and expressive cloud formations. The scene is dense with lines and shading, depicting a multitude of figures engaged in activity. In the background, there is a classical structure, and the clouds above contain forms and figures. The drawing is marked by vigorous, swirling lines that create an impression of movement and energy.

artworks.title: Cloud-Borne Saints above a Lake
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and traces of black chalk, on beige laid paper with three of the four corners made up
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with numerous figures on clouds. The image depicts a gathering of beings, all intricately detailed and set within a circular frame. The central area is bustling with figures draped in flowing robes, sitting and conversing on billowing clouds. Around the edges, cherub-like figures playfully interact. Below the clouds, a serene landscape with greenery and a waterway can be seen. The drawing employs delicate lines and shading to give a sense of dimension and movement. The central framing and the flourish of details lend an ornate and theatrical aspect to the artwork.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over charcoal and black chalk, and over some stylus lines with ruler and compass for architecture
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with numerous figures gathered on steps. The image is in sepia tones using ink and wash techniques to show depth and shadow. The composition includes figures in different positions, with one central figure possibly holding a staff. There are architectural elements like arches and columns in the background, suggesting a grand interior space. Additionally, a dog is present on the steps. The drawing conveys a narrative through the figures' gestures and poses, enhanced by shading and linework emphasizing contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Fall of Phaeton
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot pulled by winged horses. The chariot has ornate, swirling lines and is driven through the sky. A radiant glow is above the chariot. The winged horses are depicted with flowing manes and wings as they advance. The drawing uses ink and wash techniques for texture and depth. Cloud-like forms and a sky-dominating background add a celestial feel to the scene.

artworks.title: The "Giovedì Grasso" Festival before the Ducal Palace in Venice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over traces of graphite, tip of the brush with black wash, heightened with touches of white gouache (laid on thick eighteenth-century mount)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Paul Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This painting shows a grand city square filled with people. There are two long white buildings on the left and right of the square, both with large arched windows, smaller round windows, columns, and several rows of balconies. Every balcony and window is filled with people. Between the two buildings, to the right of center, is a domed structure with three tiered layers comprised of central arched openings surrounded by columns topped with statues and covered with intricate railings and details. The square is filled with people in long coats, dresses or pants, and hats, all in shades of gray. Most of them face away from us, looking towards the center of the square where performers stand on a stage, arranged in a pyramid formation using thin beams. The sky above is a gradient of gray, suggesting a cloud-filled sky.

artworks.title: Rocky Landscape with a Natural Arch
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from a slightly elevated perspective, showing rocky cliffs, an arched stone formation, and a distant mountain with a small building surrounded by trees. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes to depict texture and depth in rocks and trees. The color palette consists mainly of earthy tones, including sepia and muted greenish-blue hues. Two tiny human figures near a body of water at the bottom left suggest scale. Sparse vegetation is spread across the rocky terrain, with denser clusters of trees and foliage in the distance. Light and shadow play across the terrain.

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of Saint Euphemia
artworks.medium: pen and light brown ink with gray wash over graphite, strengthened with tip of the brush and dark gray wash, squared in red chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of dynamic figures among swirling clouds. The figures are depicted in expressive poses, suggesting movement and interaction. The overall composition is framed with decorative elements. The artwork features intricate details and a sense of fluid motion and grace, evoking a divine or otherworldly realm.

artworks.title: Ceiling Studies of a Prophet and a Putto Seen from Below
artworks.medium: oiled black chalk or charcoal, heightened with white chalk on blue-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in motion. The central figure is lying down with their arms reaching upward. Smaller figures surround them, appearing to be in flight. The drawing is detailed and conveys a sense of struggle or interaction between the figures. The style is reminiscent of classical Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Oberwesel
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite with scratching-out
artworks.creditLine: Paul Mellon Fund
artworks.description: We look down onto a grass-topped promontory that gives way to a vast, hazy river valley in this horizontal watercolor. A dozen men, women, children, and babies rest in small groups or work near grapevines to our right on the promontory. They all have pale, peachy skin and wear garments in off white, royal blue, pink, beige, or gray. Rakes, barrels, cloth, and other equipment are piled to our left. The land dips steeply down beyond the pile to a slender, tall white tower. Opposite it, to our right, a grove of tall, spindly trees partially hides a brown stone, crenelated tower. The land drops steeply down from there to a deep, wide river valley. Flanking the waterway, mounded hills mottled with harvest yellow, laurel green, and pinkish-beige lighten to icy blue in the distance. Buildings tucked among the hills and ships on the river are suggested with indistinct strokes or scratches on the paper, and a few tufts of smoke rising from chimneys or smokestacks. The horizon comes two thirds of the way up the composition. A white glow across the center of the sky deepens to lapis blue at the edges.  The artist signed and dated the lower right corner, “JMWT 1840.”

artworks.title: Along the Jordan River (recto)
artworks.medium: watercolor with gray wash, heightened with white gouache, over graphite on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, hills in the distance, trees, vegetation along the riverbanks, and mountains in the background. The sky above is blue with streaks of pale yellow near the horizon. The painting features detailed brushstrokes depicting the landscape, with a color palette emphasizing the contrast between the greenery and rocky terrain.

artworks.title: Jason Tames the Two Bulls of Mars
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene surrounded by ornate borders. The main content of the image depicts a figure in classical attire leading two cows, with a group of onlookers in the background. The scene is heavily decorated with intricate border designs featuring figures of humans, mythological beings, and animals. The central panel shows a warrior-like figure with a shield, leading two cattle, and bones scattered on the ground. The borders are rich with embellishments, including figures in various poses, some interacting with elements like grapes and cornucopias, as well as masks and architectural motifs. The imagery is detailed and exhibits characteristics of Renaissance or classical drawing styles, reflecting an emphasis on mythology and allegorical themes.

artworks.title: Medea Embarks with Jason
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This engraving features a detailed and intricate scene set within an ornamental border. The central image depicts several figures in an ancient or mythological context. A central male figure, armored and helmeted, appears to be engaged in conversation with a woman. Behind them, additional figures are depicted. To the right, a man is bent over, working with machinery. In the forefront, a child reaches up towards the adult figures. Surrounding the central scene, the border displays various decorative and fantastical elements, including a bearded figure with a horned helm at the top corners and putti or cherubs below. In the background, other figures are faintly visible, contributing to a sense of depth. The overall tone is monochromatic, with an intricate blend of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Jacob Haaringh ('Young Haaringh') (Pieter Haaringh)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of the upper half of a seated individual. Their face, torso, and part of their arms on armrests are visible. The person has distinctive features including a long face, prominent nose, thin mustache, curly shoulder-length hair, and a serious expression. They wear old-fashioned clothing with a dark garment, a white collar, and a ribbon at the neck. The background includes a shaded area on the left and a window with multiple panes on the right, indicating an interior setting with light coming through the window.

artworks.title: The Pissing Horse
artworks.medium: mezzotint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a horse standing in a cave. The horse is saddled and appears calm, with its head slightly lowered. The cave is dark, with light coming in from an opening in the background. The horse's muscular build and textured mane are depicted with detail.

artworks.title: Les Ponchettes à Nice
artworks.medium: albumenized salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: Portrait of a Child
artworks.medium: ambrotype
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows the upper torso and legs of a young child seated on the floor. The child is positioned in a seated pose, leaning slightly against a large taxidermied bear lying beside them. The child's facial features are softly defined, with dark hair styled in a neat cut. The child appears unclothed and is holding a small object in their hand. The background is a dark, empty space. The image is framed in a vintage oval matte.

artworks.title: The Onion Field
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Paul Hertzmann and Charles Isaacs
artworks.description: The image depicts a field with a cluster of buildings and trees in the distance. The horizon is near the top of the image, with a village against it. The scene has a soft, brushed appearance and a sepia-toned color palette. Tall plants fill the foreground, leading to the village and trees in the distance. The sky is overcast with thick clouds.

artworks.title: Two Women with Donkey
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Robert Hershkowitz
artworks.description: This is an image of two figures and a donkey in a natural setting. The photograph captures a scene with tall foliage and possibly trees surrounding an overgrown path or garden. One figure stands by a donkey carrying a second figure with a basket. In the distance, the silhouette of a building is faintly visible against the bright sky. The image has a sepia tone, accentuating the texture of the leaves and the softness of the natural light.

artworks.title: Study of a Dog
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Robert Hershkowitz
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a dog in tall grass. The image shows a medium-sized, long-haired dog in a natural setting with dense vegetation around, including tall grasses and blurred foliage in the background. The dog's fur matches the earthy tones of the surroundings, giving the photo a monochromatic appearance. The dog is positioned slightly to the left, with its body angled and head turned. The atmosphere is calm and contemplative, capturing a peaceful moment in nature.

artworks.title: Clarence H. White
artworks.medium: platinum print
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a partial view of a person's face, focusing on the side profile. The person is seated with their head slightly tilted downward. Their facial features are partially obscured, with light hair falling across their forehead. The person is wearing a textured garment, possibly a sweater or coat. The background is plain, blending softly into the overall tone of the image. The lighting is diffused, creating a dreamy and ethereal quality.

artworks.title: In the Woods
artworks.medium: platinum print
artworks.dimensions:
overall: 20.3 x 14.6 cm (8 x 5 3/4 in.)
mount: 15 cm (5 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: Two women are shown in a wooded area. The woman on the left stands behind a tree, leaning forward with her arm resting on the trunk. She has an angular face with visible cheekbones and light-colored hair styled neatly. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a gathered waist. The woman on the right stands next to her, holding a large brimmed hat. Her facial features are less distinct, with hair styled in an updo. Her dress has a decorative pattern. The background shows trees casting dappled light on the ground, indicating a serene forest setting with light filtering through the canopy above.

artworks.title: Mother and Child
artworks.medium: multiple gum dichromate print
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: A mother sitting in front of a tree braces a naked child who stands on her lap in this vertical photograph. The print is made with multiple exposures, some in faint peach or slate blue, which creates a blurred, ethereal effect. The tree’s thick trunk rises up and off the height of the photograph. The woman wears a white dress, and her dark hair is tied up. She leans her head down, perhaps tucking her chin into the child’s soft elbow. The child faces away from us, the dark hair blending into the tree trunk. A meadow beyond the tree leads back to hazy mountains, which come about a third of the way up the composition, under a clear sky.
